title: standing policies
description: Tunables of factory/bin/policy.sh and its policy table. ${repo} is the directory above factory/ (or the --repo flag). No tunable lives in the script. A row never matches break.glass: the owner authorises each one by hand, every time.

poll_seconds.description: seconds between ticks; a default lands at most this long after its deadline

watcher_seat.description: the seat name on every record the watcher writes

state_dir.description: ${tree:run}/policy, under the state root: one latch file per escalation already handled, and the first-start boundary

runner_config.description: the runner.json that names the herdr session, the roles directory and the playbooks directory; there is one definition of each

id.description: named on the policy.applied record; unique in the table

deadline_seconds.description: age of the escalation, by its own at, after which nobody having answered the default is taken

answered_by.description: record kinds on the same ticket, written after the escalation, that mean someone answered it; the router's own records and the watcher's notes are not among them

limit_per_ticket.description: defaults this row may apply to one ticket; a repeat escalation past it waits for the owner

decision.description: the locked decision (a graph/nodes/DEC-*.json id) the default is drawn from

do.description: write the policy.applied record, then prompt the seat with it

to.description: source: the seat that wrote the escalation; a role: that role's seat for the ticket

answer.description: the default itself, in the policy.applied note, so the seat reads its answer from the record
